mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.body, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE (#{before}::bigint IS NULL OR p.id < #{before}) ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND (#{before}::bigint IS NULL OR p.id < #{before}) ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE id > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE id > #{after} AND user_id <> #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET body = #{body}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
